packageRules.description: hibernate-core and hibernate-hikaricp share internal SPI and MUST move in lockstep (a 6.6 + 7.4 split is a runtime NoClassDefFoundError). The pom now versions both from one property, and a Hibernate major is a code migration, not an auto-bump. Keep Renovate from proposing org.hibernate majors; minor/patch still flow. Remove only together with a real Hibernate 7 migration.
